family_patterns.why: The overwhelmingly common cell-label form: the regime token appears as its own underscore-delimited segment, optionally followed by a replicate/index digit. Real matches in data/: v199_crisis, v205_crisis, v229_grid_on_crisis_r1, bt_v132a_crisis, v231smoke_crisis_r1, v233_crisis_snap_crisis_2020q1_pre_demean_w0.2_crisis_r1, v233_smoke_pre_demean_w0.2_snap_crisis_2024aug, v203_v199_crisis_s42, v226_smoke_crisis2.
Same shape as crisis. Real matches in data/: v199_trend, bt_v93_trend, v229_sweep_x008_trend_r1, v216_icsel_trend_r1, v203_v201_trend_s3, bt500_v137a_trend.

Snapshot-named cells (V231-V233 era). The snapshot id itself carries the regime: snap_crisis_2020q1 / snap_crisis_2022h1 / snap_crisis_2024aug. This pattern also matches the snapshot BASENAME recorded in results provenance.snapshot, which is why it is listed separately from the bare-token rule.

The trending snapshot family — snap_trending_2023q4, recorded in provenance.snapshot of 11 results files in data/. Note the journal says "trend" but the snapshot id says "trending"; this pattern is the bridge.

snapshot_regime_manifest.why: The AUTHORITATIVE mapping for walk-forward cells, whose labels carry a DATE, not a regime — e.g. v252_replay_2023-09-12 (snap_wf_20230912). windows[].id -> windows[].regime is the mechanical ex-post label (label_rules in that file: crisis = max_dd >= 0.30 OR basket_ret <= -0.15; trend = basket_ret >= +0.20 and not crisis; recent = otherwise). Confirmed by training_log/V253_MATIC_POL_REMAP.md:45-47: snap_wf_20240310 = crisis, snap_wf_20230912 = trend, snap_wf_20250305 = recent.

notes: SEMANTIC CAVEAT (read this before trusting a green tile): the journal's +$599 / +$2,997 / +$30 are the MEAN of a per-regime walk-forward DISTRIBUTION (crisis n=12, trend n=10, recent n=10 x 90-day windows, README.md:27-38), not the PnL of any single cell. The gate implemented here applies the family mean as a floor to ONE candidate cell's total PnL. That is deliberately a coarser, per-cell tripwire: it catches a cell that has fallen off the campaign's standing level, but a single cell scoring below the family mean is NOT by itself evidence the standing baseline moved (crisis's own median is +$65, far below its +$599 mean). Moving the standing baseline remains a journal act with a pre-registration; this file only records it.
The floors are per-FAMILY, not per-version. Do not edit them to make a run pass. V271.md:82 lists the standing baseline under "Never" for files a version may touch.
trade_count_floor 20 is carried over verbatim from omega/eval/v49_gates.py (lowered 50 -> 20 on 2026-04-06 after a 100-cycle zero streak from low signal dispersion).

There is no drawdown floor here on purpose: scripts/run_training.py never writes observability.max_drawdown_usd, so the v49 drawdown_ceiling gate compared 0.0 <= 0.0 and was permanently, vacuously green. The standing gate reports drawdown_ceiling as not_evaluated until a run actually emits the number.
